prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: production pixel-art movement parts for a Binding of Isaac mod. Use the supplied portrait ONLY as character identity reference. Create ONE transparent rectangular sheet, exactly SIX equal columns and FOUR equal rows, 24 separate sprites total, uniformly spaced cell centers. No labels, borders or grid. Every part fully isolated with large transparent gutters. Each cell is a carefully hand-designed tiny pixel sprite, dark crisp outline, restrained 12-color clusters, readable at 28 pixels; NOT high-detail miniature illustration. Consistent sizes across each row.
ROW 1: six HEAD ONLY sprites, no neck, body or long trailing hair: front eyes open; front firing eyes squeezed; RIGHT PROFILE facing right; right profile firing; rear hair only; rear hair only firing with slight hair bounce. Rear cells MUST have no face. Head silhouette round and recognizable, around 28x26 logical pixels.
ROW 2: six HEADLESS walking bodies viewed from front, consecutive left-step/neutral/right-step phases repeated smoothly, visible clothes and shoes, neck opening at top, arms resting by sides. No head, hair, face, or floating jewels. Body about 18x17 logical pixels.
ROW 3: six HEADLESS walking bodies viewed from RIGHT SIDE, consecutive walking phases. Shoes visible, clothing recognizable, no heads.
ROW 4: six HEADLESS carrying bodies: first three face front with both hands raised above shoulders to hold an unseen item, last three face RIGHT with hands raised. No actual item. No head, no hair.
Keep the character recognizable via clothing motifs and clean shape instead of dense filigree. Saturated slightly deeper colors with readable midtones; cute polished game pixel art. No logos or text. TRUE RGBA transparency. Noncommercial credited derivative of the provided character design.
CHARACTER: normal Claude-chan, orange copper hair and sunflower ornament, warm amber eyes; ivory blouse/dress with black waist and orange center panel, dark shoes. Preserve this portrait's selected design.
scope: Movement parts only; special action frames are retained and remain pending engine acceptance.
